name: mirofish-online
description: Synthetic audience graph for testing content, product, and market ideas with LLM personas and Neo4j memory

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend && npm run check:compose && npm run check:smoke && npm run check:secrets && npm run check:ruff
scripts.check:backend: cd backend && uv run python -m compileall app scripts run.py && uv run pytest
scripts.check:frontend: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
